gameplayGuide.farmingIntro: Grow seedlings at the Seedbed, then plant them in suitable soil or water to harvest resources at your base.
gameplayGuide.animalIntro: Tame this animal with its bait, then provide shelter, a suitable bed, and food at your base to receive resources.
gameplayGuide.petIntro: Tame this pet with its bait, then provide a sheltered bed and food at your base.
gameplayGuide.tameBait: Craft and equip the animal's bait.
gameplayGuide.tameApproach: Sneak close, throw the bait, and wait for the animal to eat.
gameplayGuide.tamePet: Pet the distracted animal and repeat until all hearts are filled.
gameplayGuide.breedingNote: Two cared-for animals of the same species may have offspring when an extra bed is available.
gameplayGuide.petNote: Cats and dogs do not reproduce or yield materials; petting them grants Paw's Touch.
gameplayGuide.fishingIntro: Fish with a rod and equipped bait. Fish species depend on the fishing location; bait affects the non-fish loot pool.
gameplayGuide.stepBait: Equip bait, then approach a body of water.
gameplayGuide.stepCast: Hold the cast control and wait for a catch.
gameplayGuide.stepReel: For fish, pull opposite their movement until their stamina is depleted, then land the catch.
gameplayGuide.rateNotice: Actual catch rates may differ from the values shown here.
gameplayGuide.lootIntro: These rates apply when you catch a non-fish item.

abilitySummaries.fellMonstrosity: Fires targeted Shroud projectiles and a frontal Shroud breath. Arena statues may spawn Fell Berserkers.
abilitySummaries.fellWispwyvern: Fires Shroud projectiles, breathes forward, pounces and sweeps its tail. It can summon Fell Beetles; hit its mouth during the roar to stun it.
abilitySummaries.fellDragonYoungling: Uses Fell Fire meteors, breath and aerial strafes. Wing beats knock players back, and it can summon Fell Draconian Vultures.
abilitySummaries.hollowCyclops: Attacks with its club, stomps and breathes at close range. Hollow Eruption launches anyone caught in the green target area.

sectionSummaries.explodingFellCritterCombat: Rushes the nearest player and explodes almost immediately. A red ring on the ground signals the heavy-damage blast.
sectionSummaries.explodingFellCritterTips: Pick them off from range first. Their explosions also hurt nearby enemies; avoid baiting a blast unless your timing is precise.
sectionSummaries.shroudGazerTips: Rapid melee hits can keep it stunned and stop its beam. Watch for the flinch to end; it may break free without warning.
sectionSummaries.shroudDepthdwellerTips: Destroy incoming projectiles with ranged or magic attacks, or parry them back just before impact. Avoid melee.
sectionSummaries.drakPriestTips: Destroy its orbs with ranged or magic attacks.
sectionSummaries.drakChieftanTips: Jump, dodge or use Blink to avoid its slow attacks.

enshrouded.rescueLocationNote: This marker shows where the character is found. Recipes are available through the character after rescue and may require other unlocks.

shroudLair.overview: Shroud Lairs are dungeons in the Shroud inhabited by Fell creatures.
shroudLair.essenceNote: Mine Archaic Essence patches and harvest bulbs inside. Shroud Gazers can also drop Archaic Essence.
shroudLair.uniqueWeaponNotice: These weapons are listed for Shroud Lairs overall; finding one at this entrance is not guaranteed.

locationGuide.title: Location guide
locationGuide.loreChapter: This pin marks one chapter of a lore note. Other chapters may be found at separate locations.

facts.spireTravel: Reach the top and speak with the Flame to unlock this Ancient Spire as a fast travel point.
facts.spireReveal: The Flame reveals Ancient Obelisks; reading those obelisks reveals Shroud Roots and Flame Shrines in the area.
facts.sunTemple: Sun Temples have different encounters. The Haunted Sun Temple is tied to the Carpenter's Sun Temple Stories quest.
facts.sanctumPuzzle: Night Sanctums contain traps and puzzles. Some require a Spark to open.
facts.sanctumForge: One Night Sanctum in each biome contains its strongest Gem Forge; other sanctums may hold distinct rewards.
facts.vaultSurvivor: Some Ancient Vaults hold sleeping Survivors. Their unlock quests and rewards depend on the specific vault.
facts.obeliskReveal: Reading an Ancient Obelisk can reveal nearby Shroud Roots and Flame Shrines.
facts.hallsRunes: Barrier doors open after you collect the required runes from the area or marked enemies.
facts.hallsReanimators: Destroy reanimators to stop new Hollow enemies from spawning; watch for Toxic Slime.
facts.dungeonRewards: Miscellaneous dungeons have location-specific enemies and rewards. Some Hidden Temples contain exceptional instruments.
facts.tombSpells: Certain hidden tombs are part of Eternal Spell quests and contain a specific spell reward.
facts.caveVeins: Cave Passages can contain mineable veins and hazards; both vary by passage.
facts.questLocation: This location is tied to a quest objective. The quest entry shows its steps and reward.
facts.cyclopsCollection: Collect all seven Cyclops skeleton pieces to complete the Hollow Cyclops collection.
facts.drakCollection: Collect seven Drak Relief pieces; the Bard can craft a showcase for the completed relief.
facts.shrineSparks: Interact with the Flame to collect Sparks. They replenish, and the amount depends on the biome.
facts.wellSkillPoints: Clearing an Elixir Well grants three Skill Points once per character.
facts.rootSkillPoint: Destroying a Shroud Root grants one Skill Point once per character.
facts.balefireQuest: Lighting all eight Balefires advances Slaying The Corrupted Beast and draws out the beast on Howling Peak.
facts.forgeUses: Gem Forges insert, extract, upgrade and recycle weapon Gems using region-specific Archaic Essence.
facts.mineResources: Named mines contain large deposits of specific resources. Check the local pin details for the vein type.
facts.fossilCollection: Fossils have different sizes and can be displayed in Fossil Showcases. The collection has sixteen distinct fossils.
facts.musicSheet: Collecting a Music Sheet unlocks its song. The sheet and song depend on this location.
facts.pikemeadCollection: Find the three statue pieces and display them in the Pikemead Statue Showcase.
facts.alchemistCollection: The two wall-hanging pieces are part of Alchemic Wisdom and unlock the Alchemist Showcase.
facts.tapestryCollection: The two tapestry pieces unlock the Wall Tapestry Showcase and additional decorations.
facts.dragonMap: Collect four map pieces, craft The Dragons' Map and solve the Forgotten Temple riddle for the Dragon's Wing.
